subject: Fall Semester Advising Hours Now Available for {{department}} Students
body:
USF {{department}} Advising Office
Dear Students,
Advising appointments for the Fall semester are now open for scheduling. Faculty advisors in {{department}} will hold extended hours during the first two weeks of the term to help with course selection and degree planning.
To schedule an appointment, use the link below to book a time that works for you:
Schedule via Outlook Bookings
Thank you,
{{department}} Office
